_doc: COMBAT TUNING. Every combat formula reads these knobs (Stats/CombatMath.cs).
Damage = (baseMeleeDamage + weaponPower) * levelGrowth^(level-1), then defender mitigation.
levelGrowth is THE master curve. Mob HP in monsters.json is tuned to 40 * levelGrowth^(level-1).
If you raise levelGrowth, high levels scale up fast; keep mob HP on the same curve.
All fields must be present (JsonUtility zeroes any omitted field).
